item.title: Karthik Kumar Defends Thesis on Efficient Spike-Based Learning
item.description: Congratulations to Karthik Kumar on successfully defending his MS in AI thesis, “SpikeRFF: Learning Forward with Layer-Local Plasticity and Semi-Hard Negatives.” His work explores self-supervised learning of spiking neural networks without backpropagation. Thank you to Alex Ororbia and Sathwika Bavikadi for serving on Karthik’s committee.

item.title: Manali Dangarikar to present at NAECON 2026
item.description: Manali Dangarikar will present her research, “Understanding fault tolerance of adversarially robust pruned models,” at the 2026 NAECON conference in Cincinnati.
